division: ASEAGI Sentinels — Athena, Guardian of Innocents

case_profiles.note: first case profile — family / juvenile / federal civil-rights

sentinels.name: PLUMB
sentinels.summary: Link-integrity ladder — how much of the corpus is cited to atomic truth.

sentinels.name: TETHER
sentinels.summary: Matches each statement to its scanned source; resolves twin+page+grid.

sentinels.name: DOWSER
sentinels.summary: Delta/gap analysis; hunts the missing document; corroborate or subpoena.

sentinels.name: WARDEN
sentinels.summary: Runs PLUMB->TETHER->DOWSER; one combined board + action queue.

lifecycle.verify: run verify_stack.sh (engine dummy tests + WARDEN integration + registry_check) — must pass before any merge or deploy
lifecycle.check_on_update: on any sentinel change: bump its version, re-run verify_stack.sh, update this registry (entry/port/mode/status)
lifecycle.deprecate: mark status=deprecated with deprecated_on + replaced_by + remove_after; keep a grace period, then remove the code and the entry
lifecycle.add_case_profile: add an entry to case_profiles[] (id/case/corpus/twin_glob/comm_glob/deploy_host); sentinels are case-agnostic and serve every profile
